items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Armand, Hug? When did you first meet him? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, he used to, uh, when I was, uh, with Johnny, we, we played up, up, up, up, upstairs.

ctx.x: I know it wasn't the Fern or the Alamo, uh, maybe, I don't know.

Well, anyway. That was, so, but the Fern was downstairs and that's where Armand, Hug was playing. Mm-hmm. What I was saying, on my animation, I used to go downstairs and, and listen to those guys, you know. And, uh, listen to the different guys. I, I used to, I like to go in and hear this guy, that guy, see? On my animation, or something like that. But that's when I first, uh, right, and then later on, when I come back down, down from, uh, Jimmy, he was playing at, uh, what was his name of that hotel? When? When?…
Prince Conta at one time, he was there.
